# Next.js v16 Full Guide

Use this guide for migration and implementation details on Next.js 16.

## Scope

- Async request API migration
- Cache and revalidation updates
- App Router conventions
- Upgrade regression checks

## Core Playbook

1. Inventory affected patterns.
2. Apply code and config migrations.
3. Validate route behavior and metadata.
4. Confirm no hydration/runtime regressions.
